sourceHtml:
Usage-based metering for bidirectional streaming solves a software billing problem for real-time speech AI. Customers deploying streaming models on Amazon SageMaker AI bidirectional streaming pay for the endpoint infrastructure that hosts the model. Separately, model providers listing on AWS Marketplace need a way to charge for what customers consume during a live stream. Today, we’re announcing usage-based metering for Amazon SageMaker bidirectional (bidi) streaming inference, so model providers can report actual usage for the AWS Marketplace software charge. Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint infrastructure charges still apply.

Deepgram, the real-time speech AI company, is the launch partner for this capability, bringing usage-based Speech-to-Text (STT) and Text-to-Speech (TTS) billing to AWS Marketplace. This post builds on a series of innovations between Deepgram and AWS. First, we introduced bidirectional streaming for real-time inference on Amazon SageMaker AI, which supports long-lived bidirectional streams between clients and model servers. Then, Deepgram enhanced Amazon SageMaker AI support with AWS Identity and Access Management (AWS IAM) temporary delegation, simplifying secure authentication for enterprise deployments, and expanded observability with enhanced metrics. Now, with usage-based metering, we further strengthen the foundation for production real-time AI, aligning billing with how customers consume streaming and real-time AI workloads.

Why streaming broke the existing billing model

With AWS Marketplace software metering for SageMaker AI real-time request-response inference, model providers can report a unit count in an HTTP response header. AWS Marketplace uses that quantity for the software charge. This works for request-response APIs where the billable quantity is known when the response is sent.

Bidirectional streaming is different. A client streams audio and receives transcriptions through the SageMaker AI API using an HTTP/2 event stream. SageMaker AI connects to the model server over WebSockets. A session can last 30 seconds or 30 minutes. Usage accumulates as the session runs, and the final total isn’t known until it ends. A response header alone can’t report periodic usage during that live session.

Hourly software pricing can charge customers while a model is available, including quiet periods. With usage-based metering, providers can align the AWS Marketplace software charge with reported usage. SageMaker AI endpoint infrastructure charges remain separate and continue to apply while the endpoint is provisioned.

The solution introduces a second WebSocket connection alongside the existing inference stream. When a bidirectional streaming session starts, SageMaker AI establishes two connections to the model server:

  • Data connection: carries inference request and response data, the existing bidirectional stream.
  • Metadata connection: a companion WebSocket dedicated to metering data.

Model servers opt in by returning one header on the WebSocket upgrade response:

X-Amzn-SageMaker-Metadata-Stream-Supported: true

SageMaker AI then opens a companion WebSocket to the model server at /invocations-bidirectional-stream-metadata. Both connections carry the same X-Amzn-SageMaker-Request-Id header, which the model server uses to correlate metering records with the active inference session.

The model server sends metering data as JSON text frames on the metadata connection. Send records at a frequency that matches the billing model: incrementally as usage accrues (recommended), either as each unit is consumed or as periodic batches of units consumed since the previous record. Send any final record as soon as the session ends. Each frame contains exactly one metering record, rather than an array of records. The metadata stream has a rate quota of one message per second per connection, with a maximum message size of 512 bytes.

We recommend sending metering records incrementally as usage accrues. This reduces the amount of usage left unreported if a session ends unexpectedly. Transport delivery alone does not establish that usage has been billed. Validate reported units against AWS Marketplace reports and buyer charges.

{
  "Metering": {
    "Dimension": "inference.count",
    "ConsumedUnits": 720,
    "ClientToken": "a3f2b1c0-unique-uuid"
  }
}

Metering messages use the inference.count dimension, and ConsumedUnits supplies the quantity for that dimension. If the product charges per second of audio, a record reporting 12 minutes of metered audio carries 720 seconds as ConsumedUnits: 720. The dimension name doesn’t mean one unit per request. The provider defines which audio counts as metered usage, and the AWS Marketplace offer maps the unit to its price. The listing shows one price per unit, labeled per request, with up to three decimal places. The ClientToken field supports idempotency. If a duplicate token arrives on the same connection, SageMaker AI drops the duplicate message silently.

The metadata connection runs over TCP, which provides ordered, reliable delivery at the transport layer. If it fails to establish or drops mid-session, inference continues by default because X-Amzn-SageMaker-Metadata-Stream-Required defaults to false. Set this header to true when the provider must stop inference if the metadata stream becomes unavailable. This choice trades inference availability for metering continuity. It doesn’t guarantee that malformed or dropped records are billed.

What this means for customers

If you deploy real-time AI models for transcription, contact centers, voice agents, or captioning, the new metering model changes how the AWS Marketplace software charge is calculated. SageMaker AI endpoint infrastructure charges still apply.

Transparent, per-unit billing through AWS Marketplace means usage flows directly into your AWS bill. You get consolidated AWS billing, negotiated rates through private offers, and no separate billing relationship with the model provider to manage.

Pay for audio processed according to the product’s unit definition. If the product charges per second of audio, 12 minutes of metered audio equals 720 billable seconds and ConsumedUnits: 720. An open connection lasting 12 minutes doesn’t, by itself, define the billable audio quantity. The provider’s counting rules determine the metered usage, whereas endpoint infrastructure charges remain separate.

Model providers can offer negotiated per-unit rates or fixed-price contracts through AWS Marketplace private offers.

We recommend discussing directly with your AWS account representative or partner representative.

What this means for model providers

If you’re a model provider listing on AWS Marketplace, you can configure your model server to report usage during streaming inference sessions through companion metadata streaming.

The SageMaker Marketplace Onboarding Agent Skill accelerates onboarding with an opt-in inference metering path. Its starter templates advertise metadata-stream support and build validated, incremental ConsumedUnits frames for the companion WebSocket. Review and production-harden the code before submission.

Align billing with your pricing model by defining what one unit represents and reporting units as the session progresses. AWS Marketplace charges one per-unit price for real-time inference.

The following three-step walkthrough describes how to integrate your model server to report metering data during bidirectional streaming inference sessions.

When SageMaker AI opens the data WebSocket connection to your model server, include these headers in your WebSocket upgrade (101) response:

Header Required Values Description
1 X-Amzn-SageMaker-Metadata-Stream-Supported Yes (to opt in) TRUE Signals that your model server supports the companion metadata stream. If absent or not true, no metadata connection is attempted. Without the metadata stream, the session is not metered for the model provider’s software charge.
2 X-Amzn-SageMaker-Metadata-Stream-Required No true / false This header only takes effect when X-Amzn-SageMaker-Metadata-Stream-Supported is true. If true, inference stops when the metadata connection fails. If false or absent, inference continues in data-only mode. Default: false. Choose true when metering continuity takes priority over inference availability. This setting doesn’t guarantee billing for malformed or dropped records.
3 X-Amzn-SageMaker-Metadata-Invocation-Path No Custom path string Overrides the default metadata WebSocket path. Default: /invocations-bidirectional-stream-metadata.

Step 2: Accept the metadata WebSocket connection

After your model server returns X-Amzn-SageMaker-Metadata-Stream-Supported: true, SageMaker AI opens a second WebSocket connection to your model server at the default path /invocations-bidirectional-stream-metadata (or the custom path you specified by using X-Amzn-SageMaker-Metadata-Invocation-Path).

SageMaker AI includes the header X-Amzn-SageMaker-Request-Id on both the data and metadata WebSocket handshakes. Your model server must do the following:

  • Accept the WebSocket upgrade on the metadata path.
  • Use X-Amzn-SageMaker-Request-Id to correlate the metadata connection with the corresponding data connection for the same inference session.

Step 3: Send metering messages

Send metering data as a JSON object in a WebSocket text frame on the metadata connection. Each frame must contain exactly one metering record. In this example, the product charges per second of audio, and the record reports 12 minutes of metered audio as 720 units:

{
  "Metering": {
    "Dimension": "inference.count",
    "ConsumedUnits": 720,
    "ClientToken": "a3f2b1c0-unique-uuid"
  }
}

Message fields:

Field Required Type Constraints Description
1 Metering Yes Object — Container for the metering record.
2 Metering.Dimension Yes String Must be inference.count The billing dimension. Must be inference.count.
3 Metering.ConsumedUnits Yes Number 0 or greater The units consumed since your previous record. Each record is billed separately. A value of 0 is accepted but not billed.
4 Metering.ClientToken No String Max 64 characters A unique token (for example, a UUID) for idempotency. If the same ClientToken is sent multiple times on the same connection, only the first occurrence is recorded.

Send metering records incrementally as usage accrues to reduce unreported usage if a session ends unexpectedly. Reconcile the reported quantities with AWS Marketplace reports and buyer charges to verify billing, including interrupted-session tests.

Constraints and limits

Limit Value Notes
1 Maximum message size 512 bytes Total size of the JSON text frame
2 Maximum send rate 1 message per second per connection Exceeding this rate might result in dropped messages
3 Maximum Dimension length 128 characters —
4 Maximum ClientToken length 64 characters —
5 Messages per frame Exactly 1 Don’t batch multiple metering records in a single frame
6 Frame type Text frames only Binary frames are not supported for metering

Error handling and failure modes

The Required header controls what happens when the metadata connection becomes unavailable. Set it to true to stop inference, or use the default false to let inference continue in data-only mode. This is a choice between metering continuity and inference availability. Malformed messages can still be dropped with either setting.

Scenario Required = true Required = false (default)
1 Metadata WebSocket fails to connect Data stream is terminated Data stream continues normally (data-only mode)
2 Metadata WebSocket drops mid-session Data stream is terminated Data stream continues normally. Metering stops
3 Malformed metering message Message is dropped. Metadata connection stays open Message is dropped. Metadata connection stays open
4 Data connection breaks mid-stream Metadata stream is closed Metadata stream is closed

List your model on AWS Marketplace

  1. Register your AWS account as an AWS Marketplace seller. For paid products, complete the tax and banking information.
  2. Create a SageMaker AI model package from your container in a supported publishing Region, and an AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) role that AWS Marketplace can assume to read it.
  3. In AWS Partner Central, choose Build, Machine learning, then Create machine learning product, and add the model package as the first version.
  4. Choose per-inference pricing. You set one per-unit price for real-time inference across all instance types, shown per request with up to three decimal places. You also set an hourly price for each batch transform instance type. Choose the pricing model when you create the listing because you can’t switch a released listing between hourly and per-inference pricing.
  5. After validation, request Public visibility. For enterprise buyers, extend private offers with a negotiated per-unit rate or a fixed-price contract.

Validate billing before release

Validate the integration with a Limited listing and an allowlisted test buyer. Use an appropriate offer, including a private offer where needed, so the test exercises the intended unit and price mapping.

  1. Run a known-quantity test. For a product priced per second of audio, send 12 minutes of metered audio and check that the reported records total 720 units.
  2. Reconcile the model-server records with the seller’s usage reports and the buyer’s charges. Allow time for reports to populate and verify the usage type <region code>-SMMP:inference.count.m.i.c (for example, USE1-SMMP:inference.count.m.i.c in us-east-1). Confirm the offer’s unit and price mapping rather than assuming a fixed reporting delay.
  3. Test normal completion, interrupted sessions, metadata-stream loss, and malformed messages. Compare reported and billed quantities for each case with the SageMaker AI and AWS Marketplace teams before release.
  4. Delete test endpoints when testing is complete to avoid ongoing infrastructure charges.

Getting started with Deepgram on AWS Marketplace

To deploy Deepgram with usage-based metering on SageMaker AI, follow these steps.

  • Subscribe to the Deepgram Voice AI streaming model you need on AWS Marketplace, such as Deepgram Nova-3 Monolingual Speech-to-Text (STT) Streaming.
  • Deploy a SageMaker AI real-time endpoint using the Deepgram model package from your AWS Marketplace subscription.
  • Connect to the endpoint using the SageMaker AI bidirectional streaming API and stream audio through its HTTP/2 event stream.

Deepgram’s model server calculates metering automatically, and Amazon SageMaker AI and AWS Marketplace process it. You don’t need to configure anything on the client side.

Clean up

When you finish testing, delete the SageMaker AI real-time endpoint and model resource to stop infrastructure charges. If you no longer need the product, remove the AWS Marketplace subscription.

Conclusion

With usage-based metering for bidirectional streaming, model providers can align AWS Marketplace software pricing with reported usage during a live session. Customers pay the software charge for the metered units defined by the product and offer. Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint infrastructure charges remain separate and still apply. Learn more about Amazon SageMaker AI.

To get started:

  • For customers, subscribe to a Deepgram Voice AI streaming model on AWS Marketplace, such as Deepgram Nova-3 Monolingual Speech-to-Text (STT) Streaming
  • For model providers, follow the integration walkthrough in this post to add usage-based metering to your own model server.

Acknowledgements

Special thanks to Kareem Syed-Mohammed (Principal Product Manager), Susmitha Marupaka (Product Marketing Manager), Zhengfei Ji (Software Development Engineer for Amazon SageMaker AI), and EJ Ferrell for reviewing this post and leading the development of this capability.

About the authors

translation.html:
双向流式传输的按用量计量解决了实时语音 AI 的软件计费问题。在 Amazon SageMaker AI 双向流式传输上部署流式模型的客户，需要为托管模型的端点基础设施付费。另外，在 AWS Marketplace 上架产品的模型提供商需要一种方式，对客户在实时流中消耗的用量收费。今天，我们宣布为 Amazon SageMaker 双向（bidi）流式推理推出按用量计量功能，让模型提供商能够报告实际用量，用于计算 AWS Marketplace 软件费用。Amazon SageMaker AI 端点基础设施费用仍然适用。

实时语音 AI 公司 Deepgram 是这项功能的首发合作伙伴，将按用量计费的语音转文本（STT）和文本转语音（TTS）服务带到 AWS Marketplace。本文建立在 Deepgram 与 AWS 一系列创新的基础之上。首先，我们在 Amazon SageMaker AI 上推出了用于实时推理的双向流式传输，支持客户端与模型服务器之间的长连接双向流。随后，Deepgram 通过 AWS Identity and Access Management（AWS IAM）临时委派增强了对 Amazon SageMaker AI 的支持，简化了企业部署的安全身份验证，并通过增强指标扩展了可观测性。现在，通过按用量计量，我们进一步巩固了生产环境实时 AI 的基础，使计费方式与客户消耗流式和实时 AI 工作负载的方式保持一致。

为什么流式传输打破了现有计费模式

通过适用于 SageMaker AI 实时请求-响应推理的 AWS Marketplace 软件计量功能，模型提供商可以在 HTTP 响应头中报告单位数量。AWS Marketplace 使用该数量计算软件费用。这适用于在发送响应时就已知计费数量的请求-响应 API。

双向流式传输则有所不同。客户端通过 SageMaker AI API，使用 HTTP/2 事件流发送音频并接收转录结果。SageMaker AI 通过 WebSocket 连接模型服务器。会话可能持续 30 秒，也可能持续 30 分钟。用量随着会话运行而累积，最终总量只有在会话结束时才能确定。仅靠响应头无法在实时会话期间定期报告用量。

按小时计算的软件定价可能在模型可用期间向客户收费，包括没有活动的时段。借助按用量计量，提供商可以使 AWS Marketplace 软件费用与报告的用量保持一致。SageMaker AI 端点基础设施费用单独计算，并在端点处于已预置状态期间持续适用。

该解决方案在现有推理流之外引入了第二条 WebSocket 连接。当双向流式会话开始时，SageMaker AI 会与模型服务器建立两条连接：

  • 数据连接：传输推理请求和响应数据，即现有的双向流。
  • 元数据连接：专门传输计量数据的配套 WebSocket。

模型服务器通过在 WebSocket 升级响应中返回一个响应头来选择启用：

X-Amzn-SageMaker-Metadata-Stream-Supported: true

随后，SageMaker AI 会在 /invocations-bidirectional-stream-metadata 处打开一条连接到模型服务器的配套 WebSocket。两条连接都携带相同的 X-Amzn-SageMaker-Request-Id 请求头，模型服务器使用它将计量记录与活动推理会话关联起来。

模型服务器在元数据连接上以 JSON 文本帧发送计量数据。请按符合计费模式的频率发送记录：随着用量累积而增量发送（推荐），可以在每个单位被消耗时发送，也可以定期批量报告自上一条记录以来消耗的单位数。会话结束后应立即发送最终记录。每一帧恰好包含一条计量记录，而不是记录数组。元数据流的速率配额为每条连接每秒一条消息，消息大小上限为 512 字节。

我们建议随着用量累积而增量发送计量记录。这样可以减少会话意外结束时尚未报告的用量。仅仅在传输层成功交付，并不能证明用量已经计费。请对照 AWS Marketplace 报告和买方费用核验所报告的单位数。

{
  "Metering": {
    "Dimension": "inference.count",
    "ConsumedUnits": 720,
    "ClientToken": "a3f2b1c0-unique-uuid"
  }
}

计量消息使用 inference.count 维度，ConsumedUnits 提供该维度的数量。如果产品按音频秒数收费，那么报告 12 分钟计量音频的记录会将 720 秒作为 ConsumedUnits: 720。维度名称并不意味着每个请求计为一个单位。提供商定义哪些音频计入计量用量，AWS Marketplace 报价则将该单位映射到相应价格。产品页面显示一个单位价格，标注为按请求计价，最多保留三位小数。ClientToken 字段支持幂等性。如果同一条连接上收到重复令牌，SageMaker AI 会静默丢弃重复消息。

元数据连接基于 TCP 运行，TCP 在传输层提供有序、可靠的交付。如果连接无法建立或在会话中途断开，默认情况下推理会继续，因为 X-Amzn-SageMaker-Metadata-Stream-Required 的默认值为 false。如果提供商要求在元数据流不可用时停止推理，请将此响应头设置为 true。这一选择以推理可用性换取计量连续性。它并不保证格式错误或被丢弃的记录会被计费。

这对客户意味着什么

如果您部署实时 AI 模型来进行转录、支持联络中心、语音智能体或字幕生成，新的计量模式会改变 AWS Marketplace 软件费用的计算方式。SageMaker AI 端点基础设施费用仍然适用。

通过 AWS Marketplace 进行透明的按单位计费，意味着用量会直接计入您的 AWS 账单。您可以获得合并的 AWS 账单、通过私有报价协商的费率，而且无需单独管理与模型提供商的计费关系。

根据产品的单位定义，为处理的音频付费。如果产品按音频秒数收费，12 分钟的计量音频就等于 720 个计费秒和 ConsumedUnits: 720。连接保持打开 12 分钟，本身并不能确定可计费的音频数量。提供商的计数规则决定计量用量，而端点基础设施费用仍然单独计算。

模型提供商可以通过 AWS Marketplace 私有报价提供协商的单位费率或固定价格合同。

我们建议直接与您的 AWS 客户代表或合作伙伴代表讨论。

这对模型提供商意味着什么

如果您是在 AWS Marketplace 上架产品的模型提供商，可以配置模型服务器，通过配套元数据流在流式推理会话期间报告用量。

SageMaker Marketplace Onboarding Agent Skill 提供可选择启用的推理计量路径，加快上架流程。其入门模板会声明支持元数据流，并为配套 WebSocket 构建经过验证的增量 ConsumedUnits 帧。提交之前，请审查代码并对其进行生产环境加固。

通过定义一个单位代表什么，并随着会话进行报告单位数，使计费与您的定价模式保持一致。AWS Marketplace 对实时推理按一个统一的单位价格收费。

以下三步操作指南介绍了如何集成模型服务器，以便在双向流式推理会话期间报告计量数据。

当 SageMaker AI 打开连接到模型服务器的数据 WebSocket 连接时，请在 WebSocket 升级（101）响应中包含以下响应头：

响应头 是否必需 取值 说明
1 X-Amzn-SageMaker-Metadata-Stream-Supported 是（用于选择启用） TRUE 表明您的模型服务器支持配套元数据流。如果缺少此响应头或其值不是 true，则不会尝试建立元数据连接。没有元数据流时，不会对该会话进行用于计算模型提供商软件费用的计量。
2 X-Amzn-SageMaker-Metadata-Stream-Required 否 true / false 此响应头仅在 X-Amzn-SageMaker-Metadata-Stream-Supported 为 true 时生效。如果为 true，元数据连接失败时推理会停止。如果为 false 或未提供，推理会以仅数据模式继续。默认值：false。当计量连续性优先于推理可用性时，请选择 true。此设置不保证格式错误或被丢弃的记录会被计费。
3 X-Amzn-SageMaker-Metadata-Invocation-Path 否 自定义路径字符串 覆盖默认的元数据 WebSocket 路径。默认值：/invocations-bidirectional-stream-metadata。

步骤 2：接受元数据 WebSocket 连接

模型服务器返回 X-Amzn-SageMaker-Metadata-Stream-Supported: true 后，SageMaker AI 会在默认路径 /invocations-bidirectional-stream-metadata（或您使用 X-Amzn-SageMaker-Metadata-Invocation-Path 指定的自定义路径）处打开连接到模型服务器的第二条 WebSocket 连接。

SageMaker AI 在数据和元数据 WebSocket 握手中都会包含 X-Amzn-SageMaker-Request-Id 请求头。您的模型服务器必须执行以下操作：

  • 接受元数据路径上的 WebSocket 升级。
  • 使用 X-Amzn-SageMaker-Request-Id 将元数据连接与同一推理会话对应的数据连接关联起来。

步骤 3：发送计量消息

在元数据连接上，通过 WebSocket 文本帧以 JSON 对象形式发送计量数据。每一帧必须恰好包含一条计量记录。在此示例中，产品按音频秒数收费，记录将 12 分钟的计量音频报告为 720 个单位：

{
  "Metering": {
    "Dimension": "inference.count",
    "ConsumedUnits": 720,
    "ClientToken": "a3f2b1c0-unique-uuid"
  }
}

消息字段：

字段 是否必需 类型 约束 说明
1 Metering 是 对象 — 计量记录的容器。
2 Metering.Dimension 是 字符串 必须为 inference.count 计费维度。必须为 inference.count。
3 Metering.ConsumedUnits 是 数字 大于或等于 0 自上一条记录以来消耗的单位数。每条记录单独计费。接受值为 0 的记录，但不计费。
4 Metering.ClientToken 否 字符串 最多 64 个字符 用于实现幂等性的唯一令牌（例如 UUID）。如果在同一条连接上多次发送相同的 ClientToken，则仅记录第一次出现的消息。

随着用量累积而增量发送计量记录，以减少会话意外结束时未报告的用量。将报告的数量与 AWS Marketplace 报告和买方费用进行核对，以验证计费，包括开展会话中断测试。

约束与限制

限制项 数值 备注
1 最大消息大小 512 字节 JSON 文本帧的总大小
2 最大发送速率 每条连接每秒 1 条消息 超过此速率可能导致消息被丢弃
3 Dimension 最大长度 128 个字符 —
4 ClientToken 最大长度 64 个字符 —
5 每帧消息数 恰好 1 条 不要在单个帧中批量放入多条计量记录
6 帧类型 仅限文本帧 计量不支持二进制帧

错误处理与故障模式

Required 响应头控制元数据连接不可用时的行为。将其设置为 true 可停止推理，或使用默认值 false 让推理以仅数据模式继续。这是在计量连续性与推理可用性之间作出的选择。无论采用哪种设置，格式错误的消息仍可能被丢弃。

场景 Required = true Required = false（默认值）
1 元数据 WebSocket 连接失败 数据流终止 数据流正常继续（仅数据模式）
2 元数据 WebSocket 在会话中途断开 数据流终止 数据流正常继续。计量停止
3 计量消息格式错误 消息被丢弃。元数据连接保持打开 消息被丢弃。元数据连接保持打开
4 数据连接在流传输中途断开 元数据流关闭 元数据流关闭

在 AWS Marketplace 上架您的模型

  1. 将您的 AWS 账户注册为 AWS Marketplace 卖家。对于付费产品，请填写完整的税务和银行信息。
  2. 在支持发布的区域中，从您的容器创建 SageMaker AI 模型包，并创建一个 AWS Marketplace 可以代入以读取该模型包的 AWS Identity and Access Management（IAM）角色。
  3. 在 AWS Partner Central 中，依次选择 Build、Machine learning 和 Create machine learning product，然后将模型包添加为第一个版本。
  4. 选择按推理次数定价。您需要为所有实例类型的实时推理设置一个统一的单位价格，显示为按请求计价，最多保留三位小数。您还需要为每种批量转换实例类型设置每小时价格。请在创建产品页面时选择定价模式，因为已发布的产品无法在按小时定价与按推理次数定价之间切换。
  5. 验证完成后，申请将可见性设为 Public。对于企业买方，可以提供采用协商单位费率或固定价格合同的私有报价。

发布前验证计费

使用受限产品页面和加入允许名单的测试买方验证集成。使用合适的报价，必要时使用私有报价，确保测试覆盖预期的单位与价格映射。

  1. 运行已知数量测试。对于按音频秒数定价的产品，发送 12 分钟的计量音频，并检查报告记录的总数是否为 720 个单位。
  2. 将模型服务器记录与卖方用量报告和买方费用进行核对。留出时间等待报告生成，并验证用量类型 <region code>-SMMP:inference.count.m.i.c（例如，us-east-1 中的 USE1-SMMP:inference.count.m.i.c）。确认报价中的单位与价格映射，不要假定报告存在固定的延迟。
  3. 测试正常完成、会话中断、元数据流丢失以及消息格式错误等情况。发布前，请与 SageMaker AI 和 AWS Marketplace 团队一起，比较每种情况下报告的数量与计费数量。
  4. 测试完成后删除测试端点，避免持续产生基础设施费用。

开始使用 AWS Marketplace 上的 Deepgram

要在 SageMaker AI 上部署采用按用量计量的 Deepgram，请执行以下步骤。

  • 在 AWS Marketplace 上订阅您需要的 Deepgram Voice AI 流式模型，例如 Deepgram Nova-3 Monolingual Speech-to-Text (STT) Streaming。
  • 使用 AWS Marketplace 订阅中的 Deepgram 模型包部署 SageMaker AI 实时端点。
  • 使用 SageMaker AI 双向流式传输 API 连接端点，并通过其 HTTP/2 事件流传输音频。

Deepgram 的模型服务器会自动计算计量用量，由 Amazon SageMaker AI 和 AWS Marketplace 进行处理。您无需在客户端进行任何配置。

清理

测试完成后，删除 SageMaker AI 实时端点和模型资源，以停止产生基础设施费用。如果您不再需要该产品，请取消 AWS Marketplace 订阅。

结语

通过双向流式传输的按用量计量功能，模型提供商可以使 AWS Marketplace 软件定价与实时会话期间报告的用量保持一致。客户按照产品和报价定义的计量单位支付软件费用。Amazon SageMaker AI 端点基础设施费用仍然单独计算并继续适用。了解有关 Amazon SageMaker AI 的更多信息。

开始使用：

  • 对于客户，在 AWS Marketplace 上订阅 Deepgram Voice AI 流式模型，例如 Deepgram Nova-3 Monolingual Speech-to-Text (STT) Streaming
  • 对于模型提供商，请按照本文的集成操作指南，为您自己的模型服务器添加按用量计量功能。
